basic_details.job_title: ITI Vishrampuri Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

how_to_apply: Download the application format from the official Kondagaon district website at kondagaon.gov.in or obtain it from the institution notice board.
Fill out the application form completely in the prescribed format and attach self-attested photocopies of mark sheets, technical qualifications, CTI/ATAI certificate, and domicile certificate.
Enclose a self-prepared affidavit on plain paper as required by the notification.
Write the name of the institution and trade clearly on top of the envelope.

Submit the completed application form in person or send it via Speed Post / Registered Post to the Office of the Principal / Nodal Officer, Government Industrial Training Institute, Vishrampuri, District-Kondagaon (C.G.) Pin-494347 on or before 23 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The institute has notified a total of 1 vacancy for the training session 2026-2027 under the Nodal ITI Vishrampuri, District Kondagaon.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Preference: Candidates who have passed from DGET higher training institutes ( seperti ATI / CTI / NVTI / RVTI / ITOT ) will be awarded 10 extra marks during selection.

rows.qualification: 1. Passed (10+2) examination from a recognized board, OR Old Higher Secondary examination passed with first-year graduation examination from a recognized university.2. Hindi Shorthand certificate examination passed from a recognized board/institution/shorthand and typewriter council with a speed of 100 wpm in shorthand (skill test will be taken).3. One-year diploma/certificate in Data Entry Operator/Programming from a recognized institution with a speed of 10,000 key depressions per hour (skill test will be taken).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Guest Lecturers will receive an honorarium of Rs. 140/- (One Hundred Forty Rupees) per actual working hour, with a maximum limit of five hours per working day. The maximum monthly honorarium payable is Rs. 15,000/- (Fifteen Thousand Rupees), which is subject to revision as per government rules from time to time. Absences exceeding one day in a month will incur proportional deductions. The engagement is for the training session 2026-2027 or until regular/transferred/contract appointments are made by the government, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ITI Vishrampuri Guest Lecturer
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the official Kondagaon district website at kondagaon.gov.in or obtain it from the institution notice board. Fill out the application form completely in the prescribed format and attach self-attested photocopies of mark sheets, technical qualifications, CTI/ATAI certificate, and domicile certificate. Enclose a self-prepared affidavit on plain paper as required by the notification. Write the name of the institution and trade clearly on top of the envelope. Submit the completed application form in person or send it via Speed Post / Registered Post to the Office of the Principal / Nodal Officer, Government Industrial Training Institute, Vishrampuri, District-Kondagaon (C.G.) Pin-494347 on or before 23 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copy of educational qualification mark sheets (10+2 or graduation first year) Self-attested copy of technical qualification certificates and mark sheets (Hindi Shorthand and Data Entry) CTI / ATAI / NVTI / RVTI / ITOT pass certificate (if applicable) Chhattisgarh domicile certificate Affidavit on plain paper Other supporting qualification certificates

faq.question: Q1. Is this ITI Vishrampuri Guest Lecturer post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is strictly on a guest lecturer (contract) basis for the training session 2026-2027 and terminates automatically if a regular, transferred, or contractual employee is posted against the vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply as a local resident?
faq.answer: Applicants must be native residents of Chhattisgarh. Reservation rules do not apply to these guest lecturer engagements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit or minimum age requirement?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be less than 18 years of age as of 1 January 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Will candidates with CTI or ATAI get any advantage?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have passed higher training courses from DGET institutes like CTI, ATAI, NVTI, RVTI, or ITOT will be awarded 10 extra marks during the selection process.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for multiple trades using a single application form?
faq.answer: No, candidates must submit separate application forms for each institution, trade, or subject if applying for more than one.
